{
  "findings": [
    {
      "check_id": "CKV_AZURE_40",
      "title": "Ensure that the expiration date is set on all keys",
      "resource": "azurerm_key_vault_key.generated",
      "severity": "MEDIUM",
      "explanation": "The Key Vault key does not have an expiration date configured. Without an expiration, keys may remain active indefinitely, increasing the risk of using compromised or outdated cryptographic material."
    },
    {
      "check_id": "CKV_AZURE_112",
      "title": "Ensure that key vault key is backed by HSM",
      "resource": "azurerm_key_vault_key.generated",
      "severity": "MEDIUM",
      "explanation": "The key is generated in software (default behavior) rather than being protected by a Hardware Security Module (HSM). For production environments handling sensitive data, HSM-backed keys provide stronger security guarantees against extraction and tampering."
    }
  ],
  "patched_code": "resource "azurerm_key_vault_key" "generated" {
  name         = "terragoat-generated-certificate-${var.environment}"
  key_vault_id = azurerm_key_vault.example.id
  key_type     = "RSA"
  key_size     = 2048
  key_opts = [
    "decrypt",
    "encrypt",
    "sign",
    "unwrapKey",
    "verify",
    "wrapKey",
  ]
  
  # Set an expiration date to ensure key rotation/lifecycle management
  # Note: Adjust the timestamp as per your organization's policy
  expiration_date = timeadd(timestamp(), "8760h") # Expires in 1 year

  # Ensure the key is backed by an HSM for enhanced security
  # Requires the underlying Key Vault to be Premium tier
  hsm_protection = true
}",
  "fix_summary": "Added `expiration_date` using `timeadd` to enforce a 1-year lifecycle for the key, addressing CKV_AZURE_40. Enabled `hsm_protection = true` to ensure the key is generated and stored within a Hardware Security Module, addressing CKV_AZURE_112."
}
